title: everyday parts: a hole grid, a mirrored gusset, a lofted transition, a sheet metal channel, a split block, an intersection, a thickened loft, countersinks

cases.name: c001
cases.description: a 60 × 40 × 5 plate with a hole (radius 3) at (10, 10) patterned 3 along x at 20 and 2 along y at 20

cases.name: c002
cases.description: an L bracket (a 40 × 30 × 4 plate, a wall 4 thick and 25 tall at x = 0) with a triangular gusset (4 thick) at y = 2, mirrored across y = 15

cases.name: c003
cases.description: a transition: a 30 × 30 square at z = 0 lofted to a circle of radius 10 at z = 25, shelled 1.5 open at both ends

cases.name: c004
cases.description: a sheet metal U channel (a 20 base, 15 legs, 50 deep, 1.5 thick) with a hole (radius 2.5) in its base patterned 3 along it at 15, one leg's top edge hemmed 6

cases.name: c005
cases.description: a 40 × 30 × 20 block split by a plane through it at 30° and the upper piece's top edges filleted 2

cases.name: c006
cases.description: an L profile (30 × 20, 5 thick) extruded 30 along y intersected with a circle (radius 14 about (15, 15)) extruded 30 along z

cases.name: c007
cases.description: a sheet lofted between a line at z = 0 and an arc at z = 20 (rising 5 in its middle), thickened 2

cases.name: c008
cases.description: a 60 × 20 × 10 plate with countersunk holes (6, countersink 12 at 90°, 8 deep) at (15, 10) and (45, 10)
